name: Compare Other Payment 1
definition: Specifies two values to compare related to payment data attributes not reported in dedicated fields.

OtherPaymentType.name: Other Payment Type
OtherPaymentType.definition: Specifies whether the information on the other payment types are matching or not.

OtherPaymentAmount.name: Other Payment Amount
OtherPaymentAmount.definition: Specifies whether the information on the other payment amounts are matching or not.

OtherPaymentDate.name: Other Payment Date
OtherPaymentDate.definition: Specifies whether the information on the other payment dates are matching or not.

OtherPaymentPayer.name: Other Payment Payer
OtherPaymentPayer.definition: Specifies whether the information on the other payment payers are matching or not.

OtherPaymentReceiver.name: Other Payment Receiver
OtherPaymentReceiver.definition: Specifies whether the information on the other payment receivers are matching or not.

OneElementPresentRule.definition: At least one element must be present.
